rules.explanation: Skill names require one observable action and one enduring object.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Use a single action + object construction.

rules.explanation: Active canonical names may not duplicate another skill.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Merge the records or represent the second name as an alias.

rules.explanation: A governed skill must describe observable application.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Add context, action and outcome evidence.

rules.explanation: Every governed skill must retain source evidence.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Attach a source excerpt and location.

rules.explanation: Every active taxonomy node must resolve to an active parent.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Move the node to an active parent.

rules.explanation: Active relationships require two distinct active concepts, rationale and a unique graph edge.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Select distinct active concepts, add rationale and remove duplicates.

rules.explanation: Every mapping must contain direct evidence and rationale.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Add a source excerpt and explain the relationship.

rules.explanation: Published mappings must reference an approved catalog skill.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Select an approved skill or route the proposed skill for review.

rules.explanation: A manual score override requires an accountable reason.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Record the evidence-based override rationale.

rules.explanation: Mappings must be evaluated with the active score model.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Re-evaluate the mapping against the active score model before approval.

rules.explanation: Agent mappings must retain framework, rules, prompt, score and evaluation-dataset versions.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Re-evaluate the mapping with the active governed versions.

rules.explanation: Mapping feedback requires an existing mapping, accountable reviewer, reason and valid evidence completeness.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Complete the accountable feedback record.

rules.explanation: Active role profiles may only contain unique links to active governed skills.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Remove duplicate links and select active governed skills only.

rules.explanation: Every approved role profile must resolve to an active governed job description.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Link the profile to its governed source job description.

rules.explanation: Active controlled tools may only contain unique links to active governed skills.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Retain unique links to active governed skills only.

rules.explanation: Active mappings may only reference unique active controlled tools.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Select unique active controlled tools or remove obsolete references.

rules.explanation: The public metadata layer must contain four factors.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Restore four factors.

rules.explanation: The navigation layer must contain twelve governed clusters.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Restore twelve clusters.

rules.explanation: All 38 competencies must resolve to a cluster.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Assign every competency to a governed cluster.

rules.explanation: Every factor, cluster and competency must retain source, licence, owner, version and review metadata.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Complete the governed provenance metadata before release.

rules.explanation: The framework must retain four unique governed proficiency definitions.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Restore levels one through four and their behavioral indicators.

rules.explanation: Every evidence record must resolve to a governed source.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Select an existing governed source or create one before attaching evidence.

rules.explanation: All eleven canonical agent tools must be uniquely identified, active and governed by complete callable contracts.
rules.suggestedCorrection: Restore complete schemas, permissions, data boundaries, runtime policies, error contracts, audit fields, versions and accountable owners.
